visual_text: In one Glasgow study, 23 of 25 housebound people with several conditions and medicines had missed routine reviews
Two practices in a deprived area, 25 people with two or more long-term conditions and five or more regular medicines. A small study, so it can't show how common this is.
Which routine reviews can happen at home?
Can the medicines check be done at home?
Can vaccines be given at home?
What can be done at home may vary by practice.
Duncan et al, BJGP Open 2026; Winn et al, BJGP Open 2023
alt_text: Grid of 25 house icons: 23 solid teal with hatched marks for housebound people who had missed routine reviews, 2 outline only. A small Glasgow study in two practices that cannot show how common this is.
Four questions to ask the practice about housebound people: recorded as housebound, reviews at home, medicines check at home, vaccines at home. What can be done varies by practice.
